ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a circle, point B is on the left side of the circle, point A is on the upper right side of the circle, and point C is on the lower right side of the circle. Line segments BA and BC both connect points on the circle, so they are chords, and form ∠B at point B. The smaller arc on the right side from A to C is labeled 60°. Reasoning: ∠B is an inscribed angle, and what it intercepts is arc AC. According to the inscribed angle theorem, the measure of an inscribed angle is equal to half the measure of the arc it intercepts. Therefore m∠B = 60° ÷ 2 = 30°.
